title.zh: 10 天实战 LMCache

subtitle.zh: 把 KV 缓存复用变成可验证的系统能力
subtitle.en: Make KV reuse measurable and reproducible

description.zh: 10天逐步拆解LMCache：每天有原理图、可运行CPU实验、对照结果、排错和测验。用带原始记录的工程作品连接学习与求职；真实引擎扩展和教学模拟分别说明。
description.en: Ten guided days for LMCache: diagrams, runnable CPU models, controls, troubleshooting and quizzes, culminating in an evidence-backed portfolio. Real-engine extensions are clearly separate from simulations.

hoursPerDay.zh: 每天 2–3 小时；安装、模型下载与硬件排错另计
hoursPerDay.en: 2–3 hours a day; installation, model downloads, and hardware debugging are extra

prerequisites.zh: 理解 prefill/decode、KV cache 与基本 Python；能使用一个推理引擎并阅读容器日志。建议先完成 vLLM 或 SGLang 课程。
prerequisites.en: Understand prefill/decode, KV cache, and basic Python. Be comfortable with one inference engine and container logs. Complete the vLLM or SGLang course first.

hardware.zh: CPU教学实验：Python3.9+标准库和普通电脑。真实框架/模型/GPU扩展见实验包README的版本、环境和步骤；当前发布未做GPU实测。
hardware.en: CPU exercises: Python3.9+ standard library and a laptop. See lab README for versions, environments and steps for real-framework/GPU extensions; this publication did not run GPU benchmarks.

zh: 推理性能工程师
缓存系统工程师
AI Infra 平台工程师
en: Inference performance engineer
Cache systems engineer
AI infrastructure platform engineer

outcome.zh: 一个包含逐日原始JSON、对照CSV、独立函数挑战、文件哈希与个人分析报告的工程作品；清楚区分模拟和真实框架记录。
outcome.en: A portfolio containing daily raw JSON, comparison CSV, an independent function challenge, file hashes and your analysis, separating simulation from actual framework records.

title.zh: 画清楚缓存的边界

lesson.zh: LMCache帮助推理引擎存取KV状态。Connector负责适配引擎内存布局，服务端负责存储和管理，后端决定数据放在哪里。即使两个问题文字相同，也不能忽略模型、revision和缓存格式。
lesson.en: LMCache stores KV state for inference engines. A connector adapts engine layouts; the server manages storage, and backends place data. Identical text does not remove model, revision or format dependencies.

task.zh: 给每个组件补一项故障，解释为什么答案缓存与KV缓存不是一回事。
task.en: Add a failure per component and distinguish answer caching from KV caching.

evidence.zh: day01.json的基线与changed两份记录；本人修改的代码差异和对照解释。
evidence.en: Baseline and changed day01.json records, your code diff and an explanation of the comparison.

Keep both raw outputs and explain differences
Complete both questions and your own change; do not label models as framework measurements

noGpu.en: The CPU exercise needs no GPU and validates a model or state machine. Real-framework extensions in README need the stated environment; label unexecuted work pending.

question.zh: LMCache主要复用什么？
question.en: What does LMCache primarily reuse?

explanation.zh: KV缓存保存模型中间状态；输出仍需按请求生成。
explanation.en: KV caches hold intermediate model state; output must still be generated.

question.zh: 相同文本足以作为唯一缓存身份吗？

explanation.zh: 模型、版本、token和布局也影响状态语义。
explanation.en: Model, revision, tokens and layout affect state semantics.

title.zh: 缓存键必须包含语义身份

body.zh: 教学缓存键对模型、revision、namespace和token数组做规范JSON编码后SHA-256。它防止漏掉这些字段，却不是LMCache真实格式的完整替代；布局、精度和连接器配置同样需要兼容。
body.en: The teaching key hashes canonical JSON containing model, revision, namespace and tokens. This prevents omitting those fields but is not the full LMCache format; layout, precision and connector settings also matter.

title.zh: 手算与反例

body.zh: 两个完全相同输入得到相同哈希。changed只改revision-a到revision-b，equal=false。不要用Python内置hash存长期跨进程身份，因为它不提供此处需要的稳定序列化协议。
body.en: Identical inputs yield identical digests. Changing only revision-a to revision-b makes equal false. Python’s built-in hash is not the stable cross-process serialization protocol needed here.

fix.zh: 使用固定字段顺序的JSON编码和SHA-256，不使用内置hash。
fix.en: Use fixed JSON serialization and SHA-256, not built-in hash.

fix.zh: 检查键是否包含模型、revision和namespace；不要仅保存token长度。
fix.en: Include model, revision and namespace, not merely token length.

question.zh: 只改revision，正确结果应为？
question.en: What should changing only revision produce?

explanation.zh: revision可能改变权重和状态语义，不能直接复用旧状态。
explanation.en: A revision can change weights and state semantics; old state cannot be reused blindly.

question.zh: 哈希碰撞概率低是否意味着字段可省略？
question.en: Does low collision probability let you omit fields?

options.zh: 不能，遗漏字段是语义冲突
options.en: No, omitted fields cause semantic collisions

explanation.zh: 不同语义被编码成同一输入时，再强的哈希也无法区分。
explanation.en: Even a strong hash cannot distinguish different semantics encoded as the same input.

title.zh: 用存取轨迹识别缓存复用
title.en: Identify cache reuse through retrieval traces

lesson.zh: 一次请求更快不一定来自缓存，可能只是模型预热或流量减少。本模型明确记录每条请求检索到的token数和需要prefill的工作量，关闭缓存作为对照。真实实验还要看对应进程的存储/检索日志。
lesson.en: A faster request can result from warm-up or less traffic, not caching. The model records retrieved tokens and remaining prefill work, with disabled caching as a control. Real experiments also require server store/retrieve logs.

task.zh: 给第三条请求换一个前缀，保留前两条不变，预测检索总量下降到多少。
task.en: Change only the third prefix, retain the first two, and predict the new retrieval total.

title.zh: 用存取证据验证复用

body.zh: 一次请求更快不一定来自缓存，可能只是模型预热或流量减少。本模型明确记录每条请求检索到的token数和需要prefill的工作量，关闭缓存作为对照。真实实验还要看对应进程的存储/检索日志。
body.en: A faster request can result from warm-up or less traffic, not caching. The model records retrieved tokens and remaining prefill work, with disabled caching as a control. Real experiments also require server store/retrieve logs.

title.zh: 手算与反例

body.zh: 三条相同前缀请求中，第一次检索0、后两次各256，总计512；关闭缓存后三次都0。这里假设整前缀可复用，16个后续token仍需要处理，不能把所有计算都删掉。
body.en: Three requests retrieve0,256,256 tokens, totaling512. Disabling caching retrieves zero throughout. The model assumes a reusable prefix but retains16 additional tokens of work.

title.zh: 动手调参：连接图解与实验
title.en: Change parameters: connect widget and lab

body.zh: 拖动共享前缀比例观察可省去的prefill；再运行changed把外部缓存完全禁用。交互模型假定可复用，脚本的retrieved_tokens则体现一次具体存取轨迹。没有取回计数时不能仅凭更快就归因外部缓存。
body.en: Vary shared-prefix fraction to inspect potential saved prefill, then disable external caching with changed. The widget assumes reuse; retrieved_tokens describes a concrete trace. Faster responses alone do not attribute reuse to an external cache.

question.zh: 三条基线请求共检索多少token？
question.en: How many tokens are retrieved across baseline requests?

explanation.zh: 第一次填充不命中，后两次各256。
explanation.en: The first populates the cache; the next two retrieve256 each.

question.zh: 只有延迟降低能证明LMCache命中吗？
question.en: Can lower latency alone prove an LMCache hit?

options.zh: 不能，还需存取和配置证据
options.en: No, storage/retrieval and configuration evidence are needed

explanation.zh: 需要排除引擎内置缓存、预热和负载差异。
explanation.en: Rule out engine-local caching, warm-up and workload differences.

title.zh: 理解块大小与容量

lesson.zh: 本练习只存完整对齐块。完整块数=floor(tokens/chunk)，余数是未存尾部；较小块减少尾部浪费，但增加元数据和操作数量。这是一个教学策略，不能假定所有LMCache后端都只支持这种方式。
lesson.en: This exercise stores full aligned chunks only. Full chunks=floor(tokens/chunk); the remainder is an uncached tail. Smaller chunks reduce tail waste but increase metadata/operations. This is a teaching policy, not a claim about every backend.

task.zh: 实现student.py的full_chunks并处理tokens=0、chunk=0；计算更小块需要多少元数据条目。
task.en: Implement full_chunks, handling tokens0 and chunk0; count metadata entries for smaller chunks.

body.zh: 本练习只存完整对齐块。完整块数=floor(tokens/chunk)，余数是未存尾部；较小块减少尾部浪费，但增加元数据和操作数量。这是一个教学策略，不能假定所有LMCache后端都只支持这种方式。
body.en: This exercise stores full aligned chunks only. Full chunks=floor(tokens/chunk); the remainder is an uncached tail. Smaller chunks reduce tail waste but increase metadata/operations. This is a teaching policy, not a claim about every backend.

body.en: 1000tokens with chunk256 yield3 chunks/768tokens and232tail tokens. Chunk128 yields7 chunks/896tokens and104tail tokens. At12288bytes/token, a256-token chunk occupies3145728bytes.

Generated reports organize evidence, not explanations. Complete your own function challenge and distinguish supplied code from personal contributions.

task.zh: 复现两组报告，完成student.py并通过check.py，再把一个真实反例与本人改动写入报告。
task.en: Reproduce both reports, implement student.py and pass check.py, then document a counterexample and your contribution.

evidence.zh: 两份实验目录、通过学生检查的实现、无TODO的报告和复现说明。
evidence.en: Two experiment directories, your passing implementation, a completed report and reproduction instructions.

zh: 他人能识别哪些实验真实运行、哪些是模拟
至少一条结论能从原始数据复算
包含一个限制或负结果和后续验证计划
en: A reader can distinguish real runs from simulations
At least one conclusion is reproducible from raw data
Include a limitation or negative result and a validation plan

noGpu.zh: CPU路径可完成全部模型与作品；必须标明simulated。真实SDK/GPU实验不是本机已验证部分。
noGpu.en: The CPU path completes all models and the portfolio; label it simulated. SDK/GPU execution was not validated here.

title.zh: 可复现链条

body.zh: day10会重新运行九个教学实验，保存逐日JSON、汇总CSV和文件哈希。分别使用两个输出目录，避免把前后结果覆盖。重复确定性模拟只验证重放一致，不能建立硬件加速的统计置信度。
body.en: day10 reruns nine experiments, saving daily JSON, summary CSV and hashes. Use separate output directories. Repeating deterministic models checks replay consistency; it does not establish statistical confidence in hardware speedups.

title.zh: 用自己的解释完成作品

body.zh: 填写REPORT.md的所有TODO，写明问题、本人改动、输入、对照、一个不改善的条件和下一次实验。check.py默认检查student.py；--reference只验证随包参考实现，不能据此声称自己的挑战已完成。
body.en: Fill every REPORT.md TODO: question, own change, inputs, controls, a no-benefit condition and the next experiment. check.py checks student.py by default; --reference checks the supplied solution and does not demonstrate your implementation.

title.zh: 独立函数的输入输出

body.zh: 独立实现恢复决策与稳定KV身份摘要。200MB、10GB/s、固定5ms得到25ms；若重算也25ms，beneficial为false。保持token序列不变而改模型revision或namespace时摘要必须改变；不要用Python进程随机hash()，也不要用token数量代表内容。
body.en: Implement restoration decisions and stable KV identity digests.200MB,10GB/s and5ms overhead give25ms; if recomputation is also25ms,beneficial is false. Changing revision or namespace must change identity even with identical tokens. Do not use process-randomized hash() or token count as content identity.

title.zh: 从实验到作品

caption.zh: 作品可以是清楚标注的模拟分析；没有真机实验就不写真实引擎性能结论。
caption.en: A portfolio may contain clearly labeled simulation analysis; do not claim real-engine performance without measurements.

title.zh: 在两个目录复现全部实验
title.en: Reproduce all experiments in separate directories

body.zh: 以下脚本只运行CPU教学模型，不连接真实服务；检查每份文件的evidence字段。
body.en: These scripts run CPU models only and connect to no real service. Inspect evidence labels.

walkthrough.command:
python3 lab.py day10 --out out/final-base
python3 lab.py day10 --variant changed --out out/final-changed

expected.en: Each directory contains nine daily JSON files, results.csv, manifest.json and REPORT.md.

title.zh: 完成独立挑战与报告

body.zh: 编辑student.py中的TODO，再运行检查。第一次未完成时显示NOT YET是预期结果；可以看提示，最后再核对参考解。
body.en: Edit student.py TODOs before checking. An initial NOT YET is expected. Use the hints and compare the reference only after attempting your own solution.

expected.zh: 完成后student检查显示PASS；报告的TODO由你填写，selfcheck通过不代表报告已完成。
expected.en: Your completed student check shows PASS. Fill report TODOs yourself; selfcheck does not complete the report.

fix.zh: 先实现student.py，不要把--reference通过误当自己的通过；参考边界案例定位。
fix.en: Implement student.py; passing --reference is not passing your own work. Use the boundary cases to debug.

symptom.zh: 报告只有数字没有解释

fix.zh: 补充假设、改动、反例与未验证项；请同伴从命令重算一项结论。
fix.en: Add assumptions, changes, counterexamples and unverified claims; ask a peer to recompute one conclusion.

question.zh: 确定性模拟重复三次能证明GPU加速吗？
question.en: Do three deterministic replays prove GPU acceleration?

explanation.zh: 硬件结论需要真实运行、环境、负载与波动记录。
explanation.en: Hardware conclusions require measurements, environment, workload and variation.

question.zh: 以下哪项最能体现个人贡献？
question.en: Which best expresses personal contribution?

options.zh: 展示自己的修改、证据和局限
options.en: Showing your changes, evidence and limitations

explanation.zh: 可解释的改动和证据让别人能审阅你的判断。
explanation.en: Explainable changes and evidence let others review your judgement.

title.zh: 10 天实战 LMCache · 实验包

description.zh: Python3.9+标准库，普通电脑可完成全部CPU教学实验；含独立挑战、参考检查和报告导出。真实框架路线见README，需另备兼容环境。
description.en: Python3.9+ standard library: laptop-ready teaching experiments, independent challenges, reference checks and report export. Real-framework routes in README require compatible environments.
